title: Native Audio Sweet Pine

controlChangeCommands.name: Reverb Sw
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 = release; 1–127 = press. Momentary; cannot open main menu via MIDI.

controlChangeCommands.name: Micro-Loop Sw
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 = release; 1–127 = press. Momentary; hold with loop on for memory hold.

controlChangeCommands.name: Expression
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Drives Expression Assign binding; assign once with a physical pedal first. Jack must be MIDI mode.

controlChangeCommands.name: Reverb
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Absolute set (not toggle). Intermediate values ignored.

controlChangeCommands.name: Micro-Loop
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Absolute set. 0 turns off all micro-loop sound including held memory (uses fade).

controlChangeCommands.name: Inf Hold
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 127 = hold current micro-loop (loop must be on; if off, acts as On). 0 = release hold.

controlChangeCommands.name: Trails
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0–63 Off; 64–127 On. Live only; reverts to Global Settings after power cycle. Stereo MISO/SISO is Global Settings only — no CC.

controlChangeCommands.name: MIDI Channel
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0 = omni (default ship); 1–16 = lock (flash). In omni, heard on all channels; once locked, only on that channel.

controlChangeCommands.name: Reset Knobs
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Returns every knob to current physical panel position.

x_pc.additionalInfo: No Program Change map in published MIDI sheet.

additionalInfo: Native Audio Sweet Pine MIDI sheet. TRS Type A; jack must be set to MIDI in Global Settings. No USB MIDI. Last-moved knob or CC owns control. Ships omni (CC119).
